verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents comprehensive pull request code review, including reviewing large diffs on the PR screen with third-party code reports. A community user's wish to preserve pull requests and their comment threads confirms that PR discussion exists. Inline, line-level review comments are only implied, not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline line-level comments, detailed first-party docs on opening PRs and diff comparison modes, independent hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.
